zh.title: 发布状态
items: **0.1.0-rc.24** 整合 Bot 权限继承、任务关系与图标、会话排版和核验停滞治理。正式版仍为 0.0.18。

zh.title: 修复与优化
items: Bot 的访问模式由本地统一管理，子任务继承同一份权限策略。完全访问模式下连续读取图片不再逐张重复提问；切换模式、取消和权限回执保持可追溯。
相互独立的任务按同级展示；子 Agent 使用可区分的图标，重复的结果返回记录合并呈现，保留真实任务来源。
调整聊天正文、标题和代码的文字层级。已结束的授权收成可展开的紧凑记录，连续记录有间距；待处理授权仍直接显示操作按钮。
修正回复详情中过程空态的多余留白。修复问题到期时被并发查询提前清除计时器，导致已打开的明细与计数未及时刷新的问题。
核验只在取得新的事实时更新进度。回复入口可展示已检查事实数量；连续 10 分钟没有事实进展的核验会收口并把原因交回主 Bot，避免长时间假运行。
核验报告格式修复最多补一次不带工具的请求，避免反复采集证据。更正任务交接后继续执行剩余工作，保留已有证据。
同步用户文档、累积更新日志和网站的中英发布记录。

zh.title: 升级与验收范围
items: 产品回归使用 200 个机器人、1 万条消息、10 万条收件记录的隔离历史数据；发布前逐图自审并验证产品验收包。
验收覆盖源码桌面交互、迁移恢复和发布产物。受控模型场景不代表所有真实模型的表现；实现者自审不称为独立复核。
升级前备份完整数据根，并同步升级 Desktop、CLI/TUI 与 Gateway。完整读屏、Windows/Linux 交互安装和长期日用不在本轮验收范围内。

en.title: Release status
items: **0.1.0-rc.24** integrates Bot access inheritance, task relationships and icons, conversation typography, and stalled verification settlement. Stable remains 0.0.18.

en.title: Fixes and improvements
items: Bot access modes use one locally governed policy inherited by child tasks. Full access no longer asks separately for every image. Mode changes, cancellation and permission receipts remain traceable.
Independent tasks appear as peers. Child Agents have distinguishable icons, and repeated result-return events are consolidated while retaining their actual task sources.

Refine body, heading and code typography. Completed authorization records collapse into compact expandable receipts with spacing between records; pending permissions keep their action buttons visible.
Remove excess whitespace from the reply-process empty state. Fix a race where a concurrent query cleared an expired-question timer before it refreshed the open attention list and count.

Verification progress advances only when new facts arrive. Reply activity can show the number of facts checked. A verification with no factual progress for 10 minutes settles and returns its reason to the main Bot instead of appearing to run indefinitely.
Malformed verification reports receive at most one tool-free format repair request. Corrected task handoffs execute the remaining work while preserving existing evidence.
Synchronize user documentation, the cumulative changelog and bilingual website release records.

en.title: Upgrade and validation scope
items: Isolated product regression uses history containing 200 bots, 10,000 messages and 100,000 inbox records, followed by screenshot self-review and product-packet verification.

Acceptance covers source desktop interactions, migration recovery and release artifacts. Controlled model scenarios do not establish behavior for every real model; implementer self-review is not independent review.

Back up the complete data root and upgrade Desktop, CLI/TUI and Gateway together. Full screen-reader coverage, interactive Windows/Linux installation and long-term use remain outside this acceptance scope.
